First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: easy. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Old & Slow Ride group ride

An easy Saturday ride north of Montgomery with a store stop halfway. About 16 miles, with more on offer if you want it. It has been on the club calendar most Saturdays this summer. First-time guests do not need to be members.
